ja.title: Zongertinibの体重別用量は曝露をどこまで揃えるか
ja.summary: 公開PopPKとFDA用量比較表から、固定量・90 kgでの2段階用量・連続体重補正を比較。体重層ごと4096人の条件付き解析で、境界の段差と残る個体差を分ける。
ja.seo_title: Zongertinibの体重別用量と曝露 | Daiki Kumakura

en.title: Zongertinib weight-based dosing and exposure distributions
en.summary: Public PopPK and FDA model-derived ratios compare fixed, weight-band and theoretical continuous dosing. Conditional simulations separate boundary discontinuities from residual variability without predicting clinical benefit.
en.seo_description: Public PopPK compares fixed, weight-band and continuous dosing, separating the 90 kg boundary from variability within the same weight.
